node.title: Re: Command Switch -i prints to screen not file
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: You may be interested to know that you can achive the effect of the -i command line switch from inside a script via [doc://$^I], for an example see [id://1216313|my node here]. That way you have more control over what happens than the shebang line. (However, the limitation that [doc://perlvar#ARGVOUT|ARGVOUT] gets closed after the my @input = <>; still applies.)
